GÓC CÀ PHÊ - Phú Quốc Riverside Coffee, Tea & Books sits right on the river, under $10 a person, and has the kind of slow-morning energy that's getting harder to find on this island. Books on the shelves. River on one side. Your coffee order on the other. 4.7 stars from 82 reviews and it still feels like a local secret. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
